title: 索拉卡·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 淡紫肌肤与浅色长发相映，额前单支金角，长耳与分蹄清楚可辨。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Soraka is an adult celestial woman with lavender skin, long pale hair, one gold forehead horn, elongated ears, and cloven hooves. Her full-length blue-and-ivory robe and opaque sleeves completely cover the body, while a tall crescent-topped staff retains its distinct curved gold head and straight shaft.
art_direction.scene: An expansive horizontal arrangement inside the square for the complete character silhouette, concentrated facial drawing and loose peripheral marks. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: lavender, pale blue, ivory, gold, indigo; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
